title: Metal V1 DynaVap Storage Tube
description:
Metal V1 DynaVap Storage Tube
The V1 Dynavap Storage Tube is an extremely robust storage option for holding both your DynaVap (M Size) and herb. It also features a strong magnet on top for removing hot caps. And can be broken down into a small tube for just carrying your dynaVap alone.
To help keep your DynaVap safe the, the dynavap compartment has a silicone liner. It should also be noted that the top and bottom of the DynaVap compartment is metal.
the DynaVap storage compartment is 98mm long. This is ideal for a standard M. XL sized DynaVaps will not fit in this storage tube.
Included
1 X Metal V1 DynaVap Storage Tube
